claim: Hedy Lamarr's real name was Hedwig Kiesler.

evidence.quote: sourceNotes[1]: Halliwell's Filmgoer's companion, 1983 (Hedy Lamarr; real name Hedwig Kiesler; b. 1913)

notes: The NARA authority cites Halliwell's Filmgoer's companion (1983) for the real name. The variant heading Kiesler, Hedwig is catalogue metadata and stays in the source record, not used as evidence.

claim: Hedy Lamarr was b. Hedwig Eva Maria Kiesler.

evidence.quote: sourceNotes[3]: Young, C. Films of Hedy Lamarr, 1978, p. 11 (Hedy Lamarr; b. Hedwig Eva Maria Kiesler on Nov. 9, 1914 in Vienna, Austria)

notes: The NARA authority cites Young, C. Films of Hedy Lamarr (1978), p. 11. The same note gives Nov. 9, 1914 in Vienna, Austria; birth date and place are left to the birth family because the authority's own heading and birthDate give 1913.
